name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceAppPermissionActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user chooses to download an advertised app and opens its permission details. It lists the advertised app's requested permissions and offers a download button.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to review this ad app's permissions or continue from this SDK page to its download.
